$description: ZAC design tokens. Source of truth for src/styles/tokens.css, which scripts/build-tokens.mjs generates. Every token carries $extensions.zac.source saying where its value came from. 'figma:<node>' means the literal value was read off that node of board 6:2 through the Figma REST API on 2026-09-23. 'extension' means the board does not cover the case and the nearest scale was extended, see design/DESIGN-SYSTEM-NOTES.md.

$figma.readWith: Figma REST API, GET /v1/files/{key}/nodes?ids=6:2 and /v1/images (PNG and SVG). The MCP quota on Andrew's seat was exhausted, the REST API has no such cap.
$figma.note: The file has no variables and no published styles. Every value below is a literal read off a node. Text on the board is set in Avenir (headings 900, body 400) and the wordmark in Avenir Next 400.
$figma.referenceFrame: 6:2 MacBook Air - 1 (Drew, 2026-09-23: use board 1 only, not board 2)

surface.$description: Cards, the logo band, the closing circle.

placeholder.$description: Grey stand-in for imagery that is not decided yet. The board's own convention.

rule.$description: The two 1px vertical lines on the board. Read as column guides, not used in the build. Question 3 for Misha.

channel.$description: RGB triples for translucent colour: rgb(var(--accent-rgb) / .2). Not a Figma concept.

sans.$description: One family for everything. Avenir is the board's face and ships with Apple devices only. Figtree is the self-hosted open fallback with matching 400 and 900 weights. Licensing question 1 for Misha.
